name: Jena Griswold
desc: American politician and lawyer, 39th Colorado Secretary of State
summary: Jena Marie Griswold (born October 2, 1984) is an American attorney and politician from the state of Colorado. A Democrat, she is the 39th Colorado Secretary of State, serving since January 8, 2019. She was the first Democrat to be elected Secretary of State of Colorado since 1958.
